sourceEvidence.title: Director of Quality
sourceEvidence.quote:
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, life science or a related field, an advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ in medical device or IVD quality, including 5+ years managing and developing quality teams.
* Experience improving the efficiency and effectiveness of a QMS.
* Direct experience hosting FDA inspections and/or registrar audits with successful outcomes.
* In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations and standards (e.g., FDA QMSR, ISO 13485)

$200,000 - $230,000 a year
**About the Job**
